schemes.oneloop: tree + CW(m^2) + exact J_B(m^2/T^2); no resummation (IR-unreliable where X is massless at phi=0)
schemes.AE: Arnold-Espinosa: oneloop - (T/12pi) sum n [Re(m^2+Pi)^{3/2} - Re(m^2)^{3/2}] for all scalars
schemes.DR: dimensional-reduction split: AE for X and D; for phi only the hard (nonzero-Matsubara) part of its own loop, i.e. J_B minus its zero-mode term -(pi/6)Re(y^2)^{3/2}, no phi daisy.  = mean-field potential of the soft phi zero mode in the 3D effective theory; the soft phi loop is left to the nonperturbative 3D (Ising) treatment

ginzburg.definition: eps_phi = 3 lambda_phi T/(4 pi m_phi(T)) = 1 with mean-field m^2 = 2 kappa Tc^2 |t|

adopted.nonperturbative_order_statement: DR effective quartic at Tc is positive (lambda_eff/lambda_phi = 0.9833); X and D are Debye-screened and perturbative (eps_X = 0.0233, eps_D = 0.0036).  The soft phi zero mode is a 3D real scalar with Z2 and a positive quartic: 3D Ising universality, continuous transition.  Any perturbative first-order signal below lies inside the Ginzburg region.
